procedural_matters: TUR 97 was represented by Özlem Irmak Tomak (helm).
FRA 10 was represented by Manon Pennanéac'h (helm).
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
Efe Özgenç (crew of TUR 97) attended the hearing as an observer.
facts: The incident occurred at mark 3S in race 6.
The conditions at the time of the incident were 6 knots of wind with small waves.
When TUR 97 entered the zone on starboard tack, FRA 10 was sailing on port tack and inside overlapped on a collision course with TUR 97.
When TUR 97 was one boat width from the mark, FRA 10 gybed onto starboard tack and was then aiming at the mast of TUR 97.
When FRA 10 gybed, TUR 97 was sailing at a higher angle and was approximately half a boat length bow forward.
TUR 97 luffed around the mark, leaving approximately one and a half boat widths of space between her and the mark.
FRA 10 luffed to the inside of TUR 97 and within half a metre of her.
Both boats continued luffing to a close-hauled course while passing the mark.
conclusions: TUR 97, outside overlapped at the zone, gave FRA 10 mark-room, as required by RRS 18.2(a)(1).
